all.source_quote: Must be 18 years or above at the time of registration
Applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the notified traditional trades
Should be self-employed in the unorganised sector
Must be actively engaged in one of the 18 specified family-based traditional trades

unmodelled.text: Must not have availed similar government self‑employment loans (e.g., PMEGP, Mudra, SVANidhi) in the last 5 years
unmodelled.source_quote: Should not have availed similar government self-employment loans (e.g., PMEGP, Mudra, SVANidhi) in the last 5 years

unmodelled.text: Only one member per family is eligible to avail benefits under the scheme
unmodelled.source_quote: Only one member per family is eligible to avail benefits under the scheme

unmodelled.text: Government employees and their family members are not eligible
unmodelled.source_quote: Government employees and their family members are not eligible
